variables.label: Marriage rate
variables.description: New marriages per 1,000 residents that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12611-01-02-4

variables.label: Divorce rate
variables.description: Divorces finalized per 1,000 residents that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12631-01-02-4

variables.label: School leavers with Abitur
variables.description: Share of school leavers with a university entrance qualification.
variables.source: Regionalatlas Deutschland (regionalstatistik.de), table AI003-2

variables.label: School leavers without a degree
variables.description: Share of school leavers who left without any qualification.
variables.source: Regionalatlas Deutschland (regionalstatistik.de), table AI003-2

variables.label: Church membership
variables.description: Combined church membership as a share of the state's population.
variables.source: fowid.de, "Bundeslaender: Kirchenmitglieder, 2001-2022" (EKD + Deutsche Bischofskonferenz statistics)

variables.label: Sports club membership
variables.description: Sports club memberships as a share of the state's population.
variables.source: DOSB Bestandserhebung 2025 (dosb.de), p.17; state population from regionalstatistik.de

variables.label: Crime rate
variables.description: Recorded criminal offenses per 100,000 residents.
variables.source: BKA Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik, T01 Grundtabelle "Kreise" (bka.de)

variables.label: Welfare receipt (Buergergeld)
variables.description: Share of the population receiving basic income support (Buergergeld).
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 22811-02-02-4

variables.label: Agriculture employment share
variables.description: Share of economic output from agriculture, forestry, fishing.
variables.source: INKAR (BBSR), via processed/covariates/county_covariates_bonus.csv, column "share_primary_sector"

variables.label: Industry employment share
variables.description: Share of economic output from manufacturing and construction.
variables.source: INKAR (BBSR), via processed/covariates/county_covariates_bonus.csv, column "share_secondary_sector"

variables.label: Services employment share
variables.description: Share of economic output from services.
variables.source: INKAR (BBSR), via processed/covariates/county_covariates_bonus.csv, column "share_tertiary_sector"

variables.label: Life satisfaction
variables.description: Self-reported life satisfaction, 0-10 scale.
variables.source: SKL Gluecksatlas 2025 (skl-gluecksatlas.de), Tabelle 1; underlying survey by IfD Allensbach / SOEP

variables.label: Volunteering rate
variables.description: Share of the population who do formal volunteer work.
variables.source: 5. Deutscher Freiwilligensurvey 2019, Laenderbericht (stmas.bayern.de), p.137/148

variables.label: New business registrations
variables.description: New business registrations (Gewerbeanmeldungen) per 10,000 residents that year.
variables.source: Regionalatlas Deutschland (regionalstatistik.de), table AI004-1

variables.label: Life expectancy at birth
variables.description: Average life expectancy at birth, male and female averaged.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12613-06-01-4-B (Statistik der Sterbefaelle)

variables.label: Tax revenue capacity
variables.description: Total municipal tax revenue capacity per resident.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 71231-01-03-4 (Realsteuervergleich), "Steuereinnahmekraft"; divided by population from table 12411-01-01-4

variables.label: Income inequality (Gini)
variables.description: Gini index of disposable equivalised income - higher means more unequal.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12241-02-01 (Einkommen und Lebensbedingungen / EU-SILC), "Gini-Index des verfuegbaren Aequivalenzeinkommens"

variables.label: Income quintile ratio (S80/S20)
variables.description: How many times more the richest fifth earns than the poorest fifth.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12241-02-01 (Einkommen und Lebensbedingungen / EU-SILC), "Einkommensquintilverhaeltnis S80/S20"

variables.label: Naturalization rate
variables.description: Share of eligible foreign residents naturalized as German citizens that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12511-04-01-4 (Einbuergerungsstatistiken), "Einbuergerungsquote" (BEV008Q)

variables.label: International students
variables.description: Share of enrolled students who are not German citizens.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 21311-01-01-4 (Statistik der Studierenden), WS 2023/24

variables.label: Childcare coverage (under 3)
variables.description: Share of children under 3 in formal daycare (Kindertagesbetreuung).
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 22543-03-01-4-B (Statistik der Kinder in Kindertagesbetreuung), Stichtag 01.03.2025

variables.label: Hospital beds
variables.description: Hospital beds (aufgestellte Betten) per 1,000 residents.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 23111-01-05-4-B (Krankenhausstatistik: Grunddaten), Stichtag 31.12.2024; divided by population from table 12411-01-01-4

variables.label: Health personnel density
variables.description: Health sector employees per 1,000 residents, across all care settings.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 88121-Z-03 (Gesundheitspersonalrechnung der Laender), Geschlecht + Art der Einrichtung = Insgesamt

variables.label: Car ownership
variables.description: Registered passenger cars (Pkw) per 1,000 residents.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 46251-01-03-4-B (Statistik des Kraftfahrzeug- und Anhaengerbestandes), Stichtag 01.01.2026; divided by population from table 12411-01-01-4

variables.label: Renewable electricity share
variables.description: Renewable share of gross electricity consumption - can exceed 100% in net-exporting states.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 86251-Z-02 (Anteil erneuerbarer Energien am Bruttostromverbrauch), 2009-2023

variables.label: Tourism intensity
variables.description: Hotel/guesthouse overnight stays per resident that year.
variables.source: Regionalatlas Deutschland (regionalstatistik.de), table AI012, "Uebernachtungen je EW", 2024

variables.label: New housing construction
variables.description: Newly completed dwellings (Baufertigstellungen) per 1,000 residents that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 31121-01-02-4 (Statistik der Baufertigstellungen), Jahressumme 2024; divided by population from table 12411-01-01-4

variables.label: Building land sales
variables.description: Undeveloped building-land (plot) sales per 1,000 residents that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 61511-01-03-4-B (Statistik der Kaufwerte fuer Bauland), Jahressumme 2025; divided by population from table 12411-01-01-4

variables.label: Building land price
variables.description: Average purchase price per square meter of building land sold that year.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 61511-01-03-4-B (Statistik der Kaufwerte fuer Bauland), Jahressumme 2025

variables.label: Population under 15
variables.description: Share of county residents younger than 15.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12411-09-01-4, sum of the 0-4/5-9/10-14 age bands

variables.label: Population 65 and older
variables.description: Share of county residents 65 or older.
variables.source: regionalstatistik.de, table 12411-09-01-4, sum of the 65-69 through 95+ age bands
